stories.headline: When an agent says it is done, grade the database
stories.summary: ThinkingBox grades terminal database state and repeated outcomes rather than plausible text.
stories.why_it_matters: Durable state, side effects and repeatability become evidence that work actually completed.
stories.editorial_limitation: Publisher-authored benchmark evidence; results do not establish reliability across every agent task or backend.

what_to_do_now.label: Grade one agent task by durable state
what_to_do_now.rationale: Add a terminal-state and side-effect check to one agent workflow, then repeat the task to measure whether completion is actually reproducible.
